_comment: Short-dated predictions registered only to show resolution end to end on testnet: one per outcome. The resolve date is filled in by make_args.py (the day after registration). Thresholds are in natural units; make_args.py converts them to micro-units.

predictions.claim: Net issuance over the 28 days to the first block of the resolve date is above 80,000 NEAR/day (demo of a resolution; expected confirmed).
The buyback wallet holds less than 2,000,000 NEAR at the first block of the resolve date (demo of a resolution; expected refuted).
Volume needed for net deflation exceeds 2x current volume at the first block of the resolve date (the old P4 metric, which the worker does not compute; expected void).
